title: Taz’s FTW protest becomes a world-title reign
summary: Unable to secure the championship encounter he wants, Taz creates his own belt. The protest leads to a victory over Shane Douglas and a unification match with his old rival Sabu.

chapters.title: Taz introduces the FTW championship
chapters.context: The unsanctioned belt expresses his frustration while Douglas is out of action; it is not another official ECW world title.

chapters.title: Taz defeats the Franchise
chapters.result: Taz defeats Douglas for the ECW World championship.
chapters.context: The prolonged pursuit finally produces the recognized title he wanted.

chapters.title: The world and FTW titles are unified
chapters.context: Having allowed Sabu to pin him for the FTW belt in December, Taz now reunites the two championships.
